generation.prompt:
A pixel-art character reference sheet for a game, redrawing ONE existing character in a simpler, cleaner style.

Image 1 is the STYLE and SCALE target: match its pixel size, its simple big shapes, its flat clean colour clusters, its readable faces with clear eyes, its clean dark outline, its proportions (big head, about three heads tall, chunky body). Do not copy its characters.
Image 2 shows four characters of the same game already redrawn in exactly this way: match its rendering, its pixel size and its proportions exactly, as one more character of the same series. Do not copy its characters.
Image 3 is the CHARACTER to redraw, keeping who it is: it shows him standing in six views; keep his helm, his plume, his armour and tabard colours and his silhouette, but with far less detail.

The character: a young tournament knight in full steel plate armour with thin brass trim: a closed great helm with a narrow dark eye slit and a tall red plume on top; rounded steel pauldrons, steel gauntlets and steel boots; over the armour a white tabard to the knees with red borders and ONE broad plain red vertical band down the middle (no cross, no device, no figure on it); a short dark red cape behind; a brown belt with a brass buckle. No weapon in hand, no shield.


Layout: this ONE character only, four views side by side in a single row across the image, in this order: front, three-quarter front, back, left profile (the profile facing the left edge of the image). A flat solid dark navy background (#1a2230). Plenty of empty background between the figures, no figure touching another, nothing cut by the image edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no frame. No ground shadow.

Pixel grid: real pixel art on one regular grid, every art pixel the same size, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradient, no dithering, about 24 colours for the character. Each figure about 340 image pixels tall, all four at the same scale with their feet on one common line. The helmed head big, about as wide as the shoulders, as in image 2; the visor stays closed, no face shows.

Important: plain cloth. NO emblems, NO fleur-de-lis, NO crests, NO symbols, NO embroidery and NO gold patterns on any clothing, only a thin plain border on robes and capes. Calm standing pose, arms slightly away from the body so they read clearly.
